flags: Parkway association gives 93 miles for the three-state corridor; material maps 103.6 miles and identifies an Alabama state byway. The story keeps these scopes distinct. Northbound prose reverses the southbound strip-map mile progression.
Cache provides no road-construction or designation chronology; history follows the documented yard-sale extension instead.
Dropped current “about 1,700 feet”: the source gives 1,736 feet without a hedge. DeSoto “state’s highest” is asserted only in a secondary page without comparative support and is omitted.
Mentone and Fort Payne pages give different magnitudes (4.6 and 4.9) for a 2003 earthquake. Omitted the earthquake rather than resolving without primary evidence.
The association’s yard-sale length conflicts with the sale article; omit total sale length and vendor counts. No precise future event schedule or present access is promised.
